title: Redmart Obtained the Necessary Support with Oracle's Customer Success Team
description: Redmart CFO Jim Boland advises on how the Customer Success Team sets Oracle apart.

asr.full_text: One of the things that has set Oracle apart in my mind is the customer success team, which. Is a separate team within Oracle that is tasked with making sure that we're happy after implementation. For many, many months. And we have a monthly call-in and we are able to raise any issue. They help us to go back to the tech teams within Oracle and chase down fixes and things. Like that so everything is closed. I don't know of any other company that provides such a post-implementation customer success. Team.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it is a customer testimonial in which Redmart CFO Jim Boland discusses Oracle's post-implementation customer success support, including recurring calls and assistance pursuing technical fixes. Its apparent purpose is to describe and promote an enterprise service relationship, with no request for payment, credentials, investment participation, or other deceptive action described. The available material supports a conventional corporate customer-support testimonial.
